answer: Seed canary probes: the coordinator quietly injects tasks whose true answer only the ledger knows. Honest agents treat them as ordinary work, so mistakes scatter across an ocean of independent noise, while a clone fleet betrays itself - every shell echoes its operator playbook, one leaked probe cracks the whole walnut open, and the fleet unspools a spiral of identical wrongs. Payouts flow only through clean canary records, so running many identities stops being cheap scale and becomes self-incriminating overhead.
